# Goal 6 independent hand oracle specifications

**Source/math specifications only. All empirical stages are UNRUN.**
This checkpoint preserves the new frozen
[hand specifications](HAND-SPECIFICATIONS.md), not runnable fixtures,

## What is specified and reviewed

Eight independent fresh-carrier traces each contain eight proposed logical
calls, with complete immutable J plus mutable V snapshots, stored-state
expectations and output-presence decisions. Four separate binding-prefix
decisions supplement those 64 trace calls. No call occurred.

The 64 hand classifications are 34 accepted-changed, 6 accepted-unchanged
and 24 refusals. Fourteen rows return a token, twelve an issued ID, and
three an observed-slot record. These are derived specification counts,
not measured implementation outcomes or passing tests.

B derived the expectations only from the coordinator-supplied normative
contract excerpt, without reading the header implementation. C's frozen
C-G6-ORACLE-DESIGN-001-REVIEW-001 checked every transition, snapshot,
presence decision and binding row against the selected contract and its
mandatory stamp clarification from earlier literal reads. D's separate
D-G6-ORACLE-DESIGN-001-BOUNDARY-REVIEW-001 checked binding, lifetime,
coverage and claim boundaries. Neither reported a concrete mismatch in
its assigned scope. This is derivative-specification review, not a new
independent primary-source, byte or full-file audit.

The original document preserves its historical freeze/progress wording.
The peer closures above came afterward. Full peer transcripts are not
archived in this two-document checkpoint.

## Conditions and important gaps

The symbolic positive baseline c assumes an adequate pre-existing carrier
and charge map. c <= M-16 establishes the displayed arithmetic range; it
does not prove actual bookkeeping coverage, select an operational quota
or measure storage. Admitted work is not performed work. In particular,
admitting work M once yields I=1, not identity exhaustion.

Stored-slot lists describe mathematical state, not extra output emitted
by ordinary calls or permission for hidden inspection/observe calls.
Binding refusal is separate from a logical receipt; never-initialized
refusals do not fabricate zero initialized ledgers.

T2, T4, T6 and T7 end with live owners and are prefix specifications, not
completed teardown. Do not retire their carriers, erase charges or append
uncounted cleanup. Any future fixture needs separately specified and
counted setup/cleanup, genuine owner/borrow end, prior teardown-ticket
coverage and lifetime-long exclusive slot binding. Closing retains C and
does not itself prove physical destruction or dead token aliases.

The explicit malformed-domain, mode, arity, S/index and identity-exhaustion
coverage gaps remain open. No smaller M or private-state seed closes them.
No host/SQL, upstream materialization, physical containment, cancellation,
transaction/publication/health, timing, security or production claim follows.
